rule.written_for: final models of the CMx7-SI-DyGraph thesis on CMx7-MM (LOSO, Sections 9-11 store) and COG-BCI (LOSO)

models.IG-TCAI (N1-M): EEGNet + TCAI with gamma = gamma_tcai_eegnet x (1 - TLCI_fold); TLCI_fold = I(task; c)/H(task) over the fold's TRAINING recordings, c = the TCAI conditioning variable (CMx7: rating 1-9, COG-BCI: level)
models.EEGNet + tricks: EEGNet + Euclidean alignment per subject (label-free, all of that subject's windows) + AdaBN on the test subject (label-free)
models.v3 (proposed): EEGNet + Euclidean alignment + IG-TCAI + within-task ranking loss (lambda_rank, pairs of the same task only) + AdaBN
models.recent models: ShallowConvNet, EEG-Conformer, CBraMod (frozen probe / fine-tuned), library defaults, same folds and labels

rule.transductive_note: EA and AdaBN use the unlabelled EEG of the test subject (no labels, no ratings); declared in the thesis
rule.H-IG-NI (CMx7): IG-TCAI is non-inferior to EEGNet: one-sided Wilcoxon over test subjects of (IG - EEGNet + margin) > 0
rule.H-IG-SUP (COG-BCI): IG-TCAI > EEGNet, one-sided Wilcoxon over test subjects
rule.H-IG-vs-TCAI (CMx7): IG-TCAI > TCAI (the gate removes the harm of TCAI under collinearity), one-sided Wilcoxon
rule.N1-M verdict: SUPPORTED = H-IG-NI and H-IG-SUP; PARTLY = one of them; NOT SUPPORTED = neither
rule.H-V3 (both datasets): v3 > EEGNet + tricks (our components beyond the tricks), one-sided Wilcoxon, Holm over the two datasets
rule.H-V3-best: per dataset: v3 is called 'best' only if it has the highest fold mean AND beats the second best (one-sided, Holm over the comparisons with every other model); otherwise 'comparable with the best'
rule.CMx7 metric note: CMx7 accuracy is bounded by the task shortcut (task-only lookup 0.771); within-task rho is reported for every model
rule.metric: recording-level balanced accuracy per held-out subject (3 classes, chance 1/3)
